design_principles.historical_vehicle_data: Use the most plausible value when a blank prevents gameplay; explicitly mark estimated values and preserve uncertainty.
design_principles.gameplay_values: Starting balance values; tune after playtesting, not claims about historical reality.
design_principles.fuel: One shared inventory stock in liters; engine fuel type remains a compatibility/stat property.
design_principles.offline_progression: Maximum 12 hours; return summary; no silent death or irreversible base destruction.
design_principles.vehicle_model_vs_instance: Static vehicle model separate from each owned/recovered vehicle instance.
design_principles.transactions: Atomic, idempotent, journaled mutations; versioned and migratable saves.
design_principles.no_prototype: No playable prototype or demo. Internal mathematical simulations and design tests are allowed when requested; deliver documentation/results only.

reputation_bands.label: Respecté
reputation_bands.effects: Meilleurs échanges, plus d'informations; communautés plus enclines à aider.

reputation_bands.label: Craint / hostile
reputation_bands.effects: Prix plus élevés, renseignements plus rares, patrouilles hostiles plus fréquentes.

reputation_bands.label: Paria / terreur
reputation_bands.effects: Coalitions, embuscades, sanctions commerciales et raids de représailles plus probables.

capture_enemy_survivors.notes: Par captif capturé; ajuster selon faction et témoins.

raid_peaceful_village.notes: Par événement; déclenche une rupture majeure et peut créer des ennemis durables.

voluntary_recruitment.notes: Nécessite consentement, capacité de logement et conditions d'accueil.

facilities.name: Enclos improvisé
facilities.notes: Faible sécurité; inconfort et incidents fréquents.

facilities.name: Bloc de cellules renforcé
facilities.notes: Sécurité correcte; nécessite une surveillance organisée.

facilities.name: Quartier de détention sécurisé
facilities.notes: Plus coûteux; réduit les évasions mais attire l'attention.

work_output.status: Valeurs de gameplay provisoires; les captifs ne sont pas des ouvriers gratuits.
work_output.risk: Sous-alimentation, surpopulation ou surveillance insuffisante réduisent la production et augmentent incidents, sabotage et évasion.
work_output.ethical_tradeoff: Le travail forcé augmente la production à court terme mais détériore moral, réputation et sécurité; la libération ou l'intégration volontaire peuvent réduire les risques.

events.name: Tentative d'évasion
events.trigger: Jet quotidien selon niveau de sécurité, surpopulation et gardes
events.effects: Perte temporaire de capacité de travail; blessure ou fuite possible; alerte accrue.

events.name: Sabotage discret
events.trigger: Surveillance insuffisante ou moral de base bas
events.effects: Petite panne, stock perdu ou porte fragilisée; jamais de destruction majeure silencieuse.

events.name: Rumeur dans les routes
events.effects: Baisse de réputation locale et risque de coalition de représailles.

events.name: Raid de libération
events.trigger: Réputation très basse et captifs nombreux
events.effects: Raid ciblant d'abord la détention, les gardes et les accès; avertissement préalable si possible.

anti_exploit: La capacité de détention est un plafond dur.
Les captifs consomment eau et nourriture même sans production.
Les captifs ne peuvent pas être affectés à la garde, aux expéditions ou aux armes.
Un raid contre un village pacifique est une décision majeure, pas une interaction de troc ordinaire.
Aucun effet irréversible ne se produit pendant la progression hors ligne sans résumé/avertissement.

weapons.name: Mitrailleuse lourde fixe
weapons.effect: Bonne cadence, consommation élevée de munitions.

weapons.name: Canon de défense
weapons.effect: Fort contre véhicules et brèches; lent, munitions coûteuses.

weapons.name: Mortier
weapons.effect: Tire indirectement; efficacité réduite à courte portée et risque de dégâts collatéraux.

exterior_vehicle_slots.risk: immobilisation ou perte si le secteur extérieur est submergé.

economy.fuel_inventory: Single shared stock fuel_l. Engine fuel type affects consumption/compatibility; no separate gasoline/diesel inventory.
economy.production_policy: Every building has input, output, staffing, storage cap and upkeep; avoid free passive production.
economy.scarcity: When stocks fall below 2 days of forecast demand, show warning; below 1 day, show critical warning and suggested rationing.
economy.building_economy_model: Each building has construction_cost, construction_days, input_per_day, output_per_day, storage_capacity, staffing, maintenance_per_day, power_demand and state.
economy.repair_policy: Repair costs scale with damage and class; a destroyed building requires reconstruction rather than a free reset.
economy.resource_storage: Every resource has a global stock plus optional per-building capacity; total usable stock cannot exceed combined available storage.
economy.daily_resolution: Run daily simulation in a deterministic order and journal all changes.

expeditions.retreat: Retreat is always an available decision unless the vehicle/group is immobilized or trapped; those cases need a recovery/rescue option.
expeditions.losses: Permanent losses allowed in active expeditions after clear risk presentation; offline progression must not silently destroy the player's group.

phases.name: Détection
phases.decision: Observer, contourner, tendre une embuscade ou poursuivre.

phases.name: Contact
phases.decision: Identifier menace et terrain; risque estimé présenté.

phases.name: Engagement
phases.decision: Tirer, avancer, se couvrir, utiliser compétence ou rompre le contact.

phases.name: Dégâts et blessures
phases.decision: Appliquer dégâts localisés, munitions, blessures et moral.

phases.name: Objectif
phases.decision: Continuer, fouiller, secourir, récupérer une épave ou battre en retraite.

phases.name: Retour
phases.decision: Retour normal, remorquage, récupération ou sauvetage.

combat_model.ammo_rules: Each weapon has its own ammo class; no firing without compatible ammunition; reload consumes time and may expose crew.
combat_model.retreat_cost: Retreat consumes time and fuel; may leave loot behind and can trigger a pursuit check.
combat_model.risk_presentation: Before an irreversible active expedition decision, show expected threat band, possible losses and retreat availability.
combat_model.combat_resolution: Use deterministic seed derived from expedition_id and encounter_id so reloads do not reroll a resolved event.

recovery_options.name: Réparation sur place
recovery_options.requirements: Pièces, outil et temps; exposition prolongée.

recovery_options.name: Remorquage
recovery_options.requirements: Véhicule tracteur compatible et capacité de remorquage suffisante.

recovery_options.name: Mission de secours
recovery_options.requirements: Équipage de secours, carburant et coût de ressources; risques additionnels.

recovery_options.name: Abandonner l'épave
recovery_options.requirements: Décision explicite; véhicule reste récupérable plus tard si le lieu n'est pas perdu.

vehicles.approach: Best plausible values are acceptable for game content. Each field has an evidence grade: A documented, B strong consensus, C plausible estimate, D gameplay fallback.

grades.B: well-known typical value; variant differences possible
grades.C: best plausible estimate; expect roughly ±10–20% depending on field
grades.D: gameplay fallback; do not present as exact historical fact

rules: Keep variant-specific values where they materially affect gameplay.
Use rounded values rather than false precision.
Do not block content on low-priority details.
Keep a separate confidence/evidence grade per field or data group.
If a field is estimated, UI may show rounded value without implying factory-exact precision.

save_system.entity_ids: Stable IDs generated once; never use array index as persistent identity.
save_system.idempotency: Each command/event has command_id/event_id; replayed IDs must not apply twice.
save_system.migration_contract: Every schema bump provides a deterministic migration from the previous version and preserves unknown optional fields.
save_system.save_integrity: Checkpoint before major expedition/death/raid resolution; checksum and fallback to last valid checkpoint.
save_system.offline_simulation: Advance at most 12 hours; process deterministic production/upkeep and low-risk events; defer high-stakes raid, death, captive escape or permanent vehicle loss to an explicit return summary/confirmation.

separate_axes.reputation: Opinion of the player group's actions; affects commerce, diplomacy and rumors.
separate_axes.threat: How strongly the faction prioritizes attacking or obstructing the player.
separate_axes.trust: Willingness to negotiate, share information or honor agreements.
separate_axes.fear: Short-term compliance from intimidation; can rise while trust/reputation fall.

faction_archetypes.name: Communautés
faction_archetypes.reacts_to: Trade fairness, aid, attacks on villages, treatment of captives.

faction_archetypes.name: Pilleurs
faction_archetypes.reacts_to: Convoy strength, visible cargo, defeats, intimidation and ambushes.

faction_archetypes.name: Milices organisées
faction_archetypes.reacts_to: Territorial expansion, fortified posts, heavy weapons and alliances.

faction_archetypes.name: Réseaux marchands
faction_archetypes.reacts_to: Broken contracts, route safety, reputation and resource scarcity.

faction_archetypes.name: Enclaves industrielles
faction_archetypes.priority: Parts, fuel, machinery and technical knowledge
faction_archetypes.reacts_to: Trade in parts, raids on workshops, repair services and technical plans.

thresholds.label: Allié fiable
thresholds.effects: Trade discounts, information and possible aid; agreements still cost resources.

thresholds.label: Hostile
thresholds.effects: Higher prices, checkpoints, ambush and patrol risk.

thresholds.label: Ennemi déclaré
thresholds.effects: Coordinated attacks and trade embargo; attack frequency also depends on threat and distance.

factions.retaliation_model: Raid probability is a function of threat, hostile reputation, distance, faction capability, recent player losses and visible captives; do not use reputation alone.
factions.memory_of_actions: Faction reaction is stored as stable event records; actions can be discovered later through witnesses, survivors, traders or intercepted messages.
factions.anti_snowball: Repeated attacks raise threat but also increase faction losses and recovery time; faction raids have cooldowns and telegraphed warning events.

vertical_base.layout: Base is a vertical cross-section with surface level plus modular underground floors; player can pan/zoom the base view.

underground_levels.name: Sous-sol de service
underground_levels.unlocks: Stockage protégé, ateliers légers, cellule de détention sécurisée

underground_levels.name: Niveau industriel
underground_levels.unlocks: Atelier lourd, pièces, générateur principal, réserve protégée

underground_levels.name: Noyau profond
underground_levels.unlocks: Centre de commandement, soins avancés, stockage stratégique

elevator.capacity: One vehicle or defined cargo/personnel load per trip; upgrade for heavy vehicles.

ventilation.failure_effect: Work and recovery penalties; smoke/toxic buildup in relevant incidents; no instant death during offline progression.

drainage.failure_effect: Water accumulation reduces storage/workshop efficiency; prolonged failure can damage stock and components after warning.

power.brownout: Lower priority modules pause or operate at reduced efficiency; notify player.

vertical_transport_rules: Vehicles only use elevator if width/length/weight fit current rating.
An oversized vehicle must remain on surface or use a dedicated heavy lift upgrade.
Elevator disabled means personnel use stairs but vehicles/cargo heavy enough are blocked.
Floor construction is sequential; support and drainage upgrades are required before deeper excavation.
underground_tradeoffs: Dependence on ventilation, drainage and electricity
Failures can affect multiple connected rooms
vertical_base.upgrade_policy: No underground level grants free storage or production; each module has footprint, power, staffing, maintenance and prerequisites.

content_pipeline.catalog_data_contract: Vehicle static model and recovered vehicle instance are separate. Catalog estimates may be used as defaults, but damage/condition belong only to the instance.
content_pipeline.estimation_policy: Fill key gameplay fields with best plausible rounded estimates. Keep evidence grade and note; do not imply exact historical precision.

provisional_actions: proteger les reserves minimales avant expedition
faire varier les raids selon menace et exposition
simuler ensuite les recettes exactes des batiments

simulation_progression_30_jours_v2_0.statut: simulation de conception; résultats indicatifs, non validés dans le moteur final
risques_a_traiter: affectations exclusives des survivants et véhicules
decisions_proposees: maintenir alertes de stocks sous deux jours et sous un jour
fournir une voie de récupération à faible risque après pénurie
confirmer les pertes irréversibles au retour
séparer portes, segments de mur et état de brèche
